data.name: Chandrabhan
data.gender_notes: Chandrabhan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chandrabhan is a combination of two words - Chandra (Moon) and Bhanu (Sun). This name is derived from Hindu mythology, where the Moon is considered the god of knowledge and the Sun is the god of energy and strength. Therefore, Chandrabhan can be understood as one who possesses both wisdom and power. The name Chandrabhan carries the meaning “Moon (Chandra) and Bhanu (Sun)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandrabhan usually hope their child will grow to embody moon (chandra) and bhanu (sun) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the union of knowledge and power, representing the pursuit of enlightenment through strength and wisdom.
data.etymology: Chandrabhan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon (Chandra) and Bhanu (Sun).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandrabhan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
